caption:
🌭 FEEDING ADI: CHILLI CHEESE HOT DOG 🌶️🧀
Today on #FeedingAdi -  a juicy chicken chilli, a proper frankfurter, melted cheddar + jalapeños… basically everything you want in a hot dog. 🌭🤌🏻

450 CAL | 44G PROTEIN | 42G CARBS | 14G FAT
Makes 4

FOR THE HOT DOG
• 4 hot dog buns
• 4 frankfurters 
• Cheese for topping
• Jalapeños + red paprika
• Mustard + ketchup, as desired

FOR THE CHICKEN CHILLI
• 400g chicken mince
• 2 tbsp minced garlic
• 300g tinned tomatoes
• 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning — I use @urbanplatter.in 
• 1 tbsp oregano
• Chilli flakes, to taste
• Basil, to taste
• Salt + pepper, to taste

METHOD
Add the chicken mince straight to a hot pan (no oil needed). Break it up and cook until it starts to brown.
Add the minced garlic and seasonings. Mix well and cook until the mince is nicely coated and fragrant.
Add the tinned tomatoes and let everything cook down until you have a thick, juicy chicken chilli. If using fresh tomatoes, you’ll need to cook it considerably longer to get the same consistency.
Hollow out the centre of each bun, leaving enough around the edges to hold everything together. This brings each bun down to around 60-65g.
Toast the buns, add the frankfurter, cheese and pile on the hot chicken chilli.
Finish with jalapeños, red paprika, mustard and ketchup.

PRO TIP: Hollow out the centre of your bun! You get a lighter bun and way more room to stuff in the chicken chilli, cheese and toppings. Honestly, it just makes for a much better hot dog. 🌭

Save this for your next fakeaway night ❤️
